messages:
Maria: Heads up — PR #1254 (https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/1254) needs to land before tomorrow's deploy freeze at 02:00 UTC. Windows e2e is flaky; currently failing only on that matrix. Can someone requeue CI or advise on merge timing?
Kevin: I can kick a rerun. failing job: `e2e-windows-suite` looks like a network timeout, might be transient. I'll start a rerun now.
deploy-bot: CI triggered: e2e-windows-suite — run 8943 (job queued)
Kevin: rerun started. infra shows an npm cache miss on the runner image which could add ~8-12m.
Sam: If cache miss pushes us past the freeze window, can we do a manual canary (5%) instead of a full rollout to avoid the freeze?
Chloe: code LGTM from my side. I prefer canary if it keeps other teams unblocked. :thumbsup:
Maria: Good call. But note we don't have a rebase window after 01:30 UTC, freeze at 02:00 — if this rerun flakes twice we may be forced to wait.
Kevin: ETA on this rerun ~12m. If it fails again, rebase onto main picks up flaky-fix from #1247 which might fix it. Rebase would take a couple minutes but needs a rebase slot.
Sam: Can we ask ops to extend the rebase window by 30m? @Tom can you check with ops lead?
Kevin: pinging oncall: @Tom
Tom: Oncall here — ops lead isn't available right now, we generally can't expand the freeze without signoff. Manual canary is the safest route.
Maria: Ok, plan: wait for rerun. If green, merge to main and kick a manual canary to 5% traffic; monitor for 30m then promote. If rerun fails again, re-evaluate (either rebase in the limited slot or hold).
Kevin: rerun finished — all checks green. Ready to merge pending approvals (Chloe approved).
Maria: Merging now. I'll start the canary script after merge and watch the dashboards.
deploy-bot: Merge completed: PR #1254 merged into main by Maria. Canary deployment initiated.
Chloe: Watching logs and SLOs. so far so good.
Kevin: No obvious errors in canary logs, latency unaffected.
Maria: Canary at 5% for 30m, then promote. Thanks for the quick responses everyone. I'll open a follow-up if anything crops up. :rocket:
